annotation.title_clean: Artificial intelligence in the military domain and its implications for international peace and security
annotation.title_en: Artificial intelligence in the military domain and its implications for international peace and security
annotation.summary_en: UN General Assembly resolution 79/239 affirms that international law, including IHL and human rights law, applies across the life cycle of military AI. It encourages state dialogue and capacity-building, and requests a Secretary-General report on views and normative proposals, focusing on areas other than lethal autonomous weapons, for the 80th session.
key_provisions_or_claims: Affirms international law, including the UN Charter, IHL and human rights law, applies throughout the military AI life cycle
Encourages states to pursue national, regional and global efforts and multilateral dialogue on military AI
Calls for voluntary cooperation to bridge AI divides with developing countries
Requests the Secretary-General to collect views and catalogue normative proposals, excluding LAWS, for the 80th session
Adds a sub-item on military AI to the General Assembly's 80th session agenda
